records.author: OKHP3
records.body:
The scheduled technology drift check failed in run 31394658654 because the declared versions are behind the upstream signals:
- Teams manifest: 1.21 declared, 1.30 latest observed
- Declarative Agent: v1.5 declared, v1.8 latest observed

This is a compatibility-review signal, not an instruction to blindly rewrite the manifest. Review the Teams schema and Declarative Agent compatibility before changing the repository. Source workflow: .github/workflows/technology-drift.yml. Original notification/check: 25011896549.

comments.author: OKHP3
comments.body: Closing as resolved: PR #3 aligned the schemas. The latest technology audit (run 37318185759) confirms Teams 1.30 and Declarative Agent v1.8, with no actionable drift.
